initial_simplification: Scientists who study the brain use advanced tools, like functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), to explore how the brain works during important thinking activities. These activities include things like remembering, making choices, and understanding language.

prompt_used: You simplify complex texts for children. The FKGL score of the output (Flesh-Kincaid Grade Level) approximates the reading grade of the text, using the following formula: 0.39 x (words/sentences) + 11.8 x (syllables/words) – 15.59. Target FKGL score of your simplification equals 11.
source_text: Neuroscientists have long utilized sophisticated imaging techniques, such as functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), to investigate the intricate neural mechanisms underlying cognitive processes like memory formation, decision-making, and language comprehension.
target_text: Scientists who study the brain have long used special tools, like functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), to explore how our brains work when we remember things, make decisions, and understand language.
